text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home after my day out with

Kawakami Princess, a group of laughing
children
run past us.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey! You ruined my magic circle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Did something happen, Sweep?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's the absolute worst! Those are the
brats
everyone at the academy has been
talking about!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: They completely messed up the magic circle I was drawing! Grrrr! Now I gotta start all over!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, don't you worry for a second! I'll
go and
teach them a lesson!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Almost before the words finish leaving
her mouth, Kawakami Princess dashes
off. I hurry after her in
a panic, only to
find...

text_block_list.name: Timid Rascal
text_block_list.text:
Oi, this is bad, Boss! She's followed us
all the way
to our base!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, that's no big deal! What's a
stupid-lookin'
Umamusume like her
gonna do to us?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Stupid-looking?! For a little kid, you've
got a lot
of nerve...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But you're just the kind of adversary I
like! Let me respond to that fiery spirit
of yours with a hearty
dose of princess
discipline!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Maybe you have a point—it
wouldn't be
very princess-like to go all
out against a child!
choice_data_list: Like, maybe a slightly more peacef...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My conduct must always befit a
princess—in that it must be beautiful,
graceful, and courageous! All
right, I'll
do this fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You there—you look like the leader of
these
rascals! On my honor as a princess,
I challenge
you to a duel!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text: Huuuh? A duel?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Of course, since you're just a little
kid, I'll
allow you an advantage!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But if I win, then you and your group will
have to stop your pranks. So? Do you
have the courage
to accept my
challenge?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text: Heh! You're on!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haaah! That makes five victories in a row
for me!

text_block_list.name: Lively Rascal
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what do we do, Boss?! She took all
your milk
caps!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text:
H-how?! How's she this good when she's
only usin'
her pinkie and ring fingers?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Heh... That makes seventeen straight wins in hide-and-seek, tag, and kendama! Not to mention I was at a disadvantage for all of them!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The results are clear!
It's time for you to
stop and
reflect on your misdoings—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text: A-amazin'! You're incredible!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why're you so good at everythin'?!
Are you
usin' some kind of trick?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. Well, you see, not too long ago, I was the leader of all the rascals 'round town—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ack! A-ahem, I mean... being adaptable
is a
natural skill of any princess!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text:
COOL! So, um... can I be your
apprentice?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My apprentice? Hehe, I guess that
wouldn't be a
problem...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My apprentice? Hehe, I guess that
wouldn't be a
problem...

At this rate, we'll conquer the wh...
At this rate, we'll conquer the wh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Well, since my trainer's on board, okay!
From this
day forward, you are officially
a princess
apprentice!
choice_data_list: Since we have the chance, let's te...
At this rate, we'll conquer the wh...
At this rate, we'll conquer the wh...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeeeah! Okay, so first, teach me that
technique
you used before!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Certainly! Once I'm done with you, your
skills will
know no equal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After this, Kawakami Princess teaches
the
children all sorts of things, from her
secret
techniques to entirely new games.

text_block_list.name: Perky Rascal
text_block_list.text:
Good call! This princess lady's basically
invincible! With her on our side, we can
crush those chumps
over in the next
park!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Wearing a Cap
text_block_list.text:
All right, lady! Let's get goin'! C'mon,
this way,
this way!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
H-huh? Uh, why am I coming?! P-please
wait a
momen—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by the insistent crowd of
chattering children, Kawakami Princess
finds herself dragged
along on a quest
for small-scale conquest.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaahhh! At this rate, I'm just a rascal
leader,
not a princess!
